aspect-runner.platform: 8086 DOS, small model, near DS=SS, cdecl, 8192-byte stack
aspect-runner.scope: DOS CLI for trusted source-compiled ASX; partial63-slot runtime. Optional owned UART with validated parent ASIO handback; native TRANSMIT/WAITFOR with raw receive backend. No complete script/UI scheduling or arbitrary-bytecode safety.

build/aspect-resident-service/checks.jso.scope: Actual source instructions in controlled realmodeCPU: modeledDOS62,BIOSclock,UARTLSR, injectedchildinterrupts honoringIF; completeSS/SP/DS switch windows monitored. Actual EXEC/BIOS timer verified separately underDOS. Does not measure arbitrary renderer stack depth.

build/aspect-resident-service/checks-dos.scope: Source-owned parent EXEC child, real8086 DOS,1024B stack slices,32B redzones,32calls IF0/1, nested child realCOM1 LSR callbacks/depth1 refusal, softwareINT60 and realINT1C child ISR on parent stack. No renderer/product ASIO integration, arbitrary reentrancy, NMIs or physical UART IRQ claim.

build/aspect-resident-bridge/checks.json.scope: Actual relocated OMF bridge/body and child callback instructions, controlled DOSPSP/BIOSclock/UART,IF-obeying child interrupt injection. Normal/deepabort/lowhighpreguard faults, invalidinit oldlease preserved, complete callerFLAGS/registers/DS=SS/redzones. Actual EXEC and realtimer separately DOS verified.

limitations: Kernel/ports modeled; actualDOS loopback test separately required.
Standard COM1..4 ports/IRQ masks are modeled; separate actual DOS backend tests use COM1 only.
Source-built direct owner diagnostic, not ASPECT interpreter or parent terminal composition.
COM1/COM2 virtual UART only; physical devices remain unverified.
build/aspect-serial-unread-dos/checks.js.scope: Actual8086DOS checked UART owner, one-shot raw unread/read for every preloaded byte and4 live IRQ bytes, separate COM1/COM2 peers. Ring wrapping, table mode,7-bit dequeue and exact raw ASIO suffix; IF0/overflow-race proof is the separate linked CPU suite.

build/aspect-runner/checks.json.scope: Actual production DOS CLI spawned21 times with independent handles; exact stdout/stderr, statuses, BIOS Escape, native delay, malformed serial handoff admission and INT0 restoration. Fixed trusted source cases, not arbitrary-bytecode safety or complete serial scripting.

limits: Mechanical bridge fixtures are separate from the actual terminal renderer.
Touched stack bytes in tiny fixtures do not establish renderer maximum stack usage.
Timer and controlled software interrupts do not establish physical UART IRQ behavior.
Application lease/MCB/descriptor validation, owner guards and whole-service budgets remain.
Full parser/callback integration, view adoption and MESSAGE/diagnostic routing remain.
Strict automatic Synchronet editor failure remains retained in directory-scripts.json.
All full-application gates, remaining ASPECT features and hardware validation remain.
